full_judgment: 2. The facts involved in the case, in short, are that the land measuring 0.12 acre in S.A. Khatian No.370 under mouza No.36 of Rahihnipara, belongs to Abdul Jalil and his sister Fatejannessa and 0.28 acre of land of Khatian No.369 and 0.17 acre of land under Khatian No.472 belonged to Abdul Jalil and Khatejannessa. Besides, 0.27 acre of land under S.A. Khatian No.476 belonged to him and Khatejannessa. Abdul Jalil Sheikh used to possess 0.13 acre of land out of 0.55 acre of land. He died leaving behind a son Abdul Latif and two daughters Md. Serajunnessa and Most. Noorjahan. The plaintiffs used to possess the land along with his brother and with other co-sharers. The plaintiffs' brother Abdul Latif lives in the land. For this reason the plaintiffs decided to gift the land in favour of Abdul Latif. The plaintiffs are illiterate village people and the defendants claimed the land except plot No.55 on 31st Shravan, 1404 B.S. Thereafter the plaintiffs came to know that 0.29½ acre of land has been shown transferred with five other plots along with plot No.55 on 28.10.1986. The plaintiffs came to know definitely about the said deed after procuring the certified copy on 21.08.1997. The plaintiffs did not sell the land to the defendants and no consideration money has been paid. Hence the cause of action arose.
